g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud static website with Cloud CDN, a Cloud Run API and Cloud Build from GitHub

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: The site's name resolves in Cloud DNS to the load balancer's anycast IP
The HTTPS proxy ends TLS with a Certificate Manager certificate
The URL map serves pages and assets from the site bucket through Cloud CDN
Members sign in with Identity Platform
Calls to /api go through Cloud Armor to the API on Cloud Run
which reads member content from Firestore
Contact form messages go through Pub/Sub to a function that emails the team
A pull request or merge in GitHub notifies Cloud Build
Each pull request builds a preview copy of the site
A merge to main builds the site and syncs it to the site bucket
and deploys the new API image to Cloud Run
